note: External research mapping: application city slug -> Habous 'ville' external identifier and Arabic name. This file is research/audit input only; it does NOT modify the production city model (MoroccoCityRegistry / morocco-cities.json) and does not change production prayer outputs.
verificationNote: habousCityId is the numeric Habous 'ville' identifier used by https://www.habous.gov.ma/prieres/index.php?ville=<id>. Entries with verified=true have been confirmed against the live Habous URL (rabat=1, casablanca=58, fez=81, laayoune=156). Entries with verified=false still hold an Arabic-name placeholder and must be replaced with the real numeric ville id before they can be fetched. 'all-mapped' collection fetches every entry but records the verification status.
ifraneNote: Ifrane is listed in the research split but has no entry here because there is no 'ifrane' city in the application city model; per the 'do not redesign the city model' constraint it cannot be mapped until an application city exists.
